metadata.source_document: P. D. Hinduja Hospital & Medical Research Centre — Antibiotic Protocol Pocket Guide

index.description: Local Antibiogram and Empirical Antibiotic Choice
Synergy Testing of Ceftazidime-Avibactam and Aztreonam and Antifungal Susceptibility for Aspergillus spp. and Candida spp.

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Mycoplasma, Chlamydia, respiratory viruses
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 1.2g IV q8h OR Ceftriaxone 1g IV q12h + Azithromycin 500mg OD OR Doxycycline 100mg BD
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: For patients with structural lung disease / recent antibiotic use / immunosuppression: Piperacillin-tazobactam IV 4.5g q8h + Azithromycin OR Doxycycline
icmr_guidelines.comments: Avoid FQNs. Oseltamivir only if clinical suspicion of H1N1

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Staph aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Gram-negative Enterobacteriaceae
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam IV 4.5g q6-8h OR Cefoperazone-sulbactam (2:1) 3g IV q12h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 1g IV q8h OR Imipenem 500mg IV q6h OR Doripenem 500mg–1g IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Consider polymyxin B / colistin / ceftazidime-avibactam + aztreonam (ID consult advised) if risk factors for CRE. Vancomycin / linezolid if MRSA risk factors

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: MDR Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas spp., Acinetobacter spp., Staph aureus (MRSA), invasive mold infections
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Meropenem 1g q8h OR Imipenem 500mg q6h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h + Vancomycin 25-30 mg/kg loading then 15 mg/kg q8-12h (target trough 15-20 mcg/ml) OR Linezolid 600 mg BD
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Polymyxin B IV 15 lac units LD then 5 lac units q8h + Carbapenem + Vancomycin (as above) OR Linezolid 600 mg BD
icmr_guidelines.comments: For CRE: ceftazidime-avibactam + aztreonam (ID consult advised). Voriconazole / Liposomal Amphotericin B for invasive mold infection (ID consult advised)

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Polymicrobial (Anaerobes, Staph aureus, GNB)
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ampicillin-sulbactam 3g IV q6h +/- Clindamycin 600mg IV q8h. Combination regimens — Nocardia: Amikacin / Linezolid / TMP-SMX
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam IV 4.5g q6-8h OR Meropenem 1g q8h OR Imipenem 500mg q6h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Anaerobic cover not routinely required with BLBLI / carbapenem use. Prolonged treatment on OPD basis with amoxicillin-clavulanate

icmr_guidelines.clinical_condition: Susceptible host (Nocardia spp., Actinomyces spp., Burkholderia pseudomallei)
icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Nocardia spp., Actinomyces spp., Burkholderia pseudomallei
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Empirical treatment discouraged. Actinomyces: Penicillin G 18-24 mil U/day (2-6 weeks) f/b amoxicillin 500-750mg TDS/QDS. Melioidosis: Ceftazidime / meropenem +/- TMP-SMX. Nocardia: ceftriaxone / imipenem / moxifloxacin / minocycline
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Nocardia: ceftriaxone / imipenem / moxifloxacin / minocycline. Actinomyces: doxycycline, clindamycin. TMP-SMX / doxycycline / amoxicillin-clavulanate
icmr_guidelines.comments: ID consult advised for patients at risk of opportunistic pathogens. Empirical treatment discouraged

icmr_guidelines.clinical_condition: Native Valve / Late Prosthetic Valve Infective Endocarditis (>1yr)
icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: VGS, S. aureus, β-hemolytic streptococci, HACEK, enterococcus
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ampicillin 2g IV q4h (12g/d) + Cloxacillin/Flucloxacillin 2g IV q4h (12g/d) / Cefazolin 2g IV q8h + Gentamicin 3mg/kg/d single dose
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Vancomycin 30-60 mg/kg/day in 2-3 doses (target trough 15-20 mcg/ml) + Gentamicin 3mg/kg/d single dose
icmr_guidelines.comments: Daptomycin 10 mg/kg/d may be considered if unable to use vancomycin (ID consult advised)

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Staph aureus, CONS, enterococci, and aerobic Gram-negative bacilli
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h + Vancomycin 30-60 mg/kg/day in 2-3 doses (target trough 15-20 mcg/ml) + Rifampicin 900-1200 mg/d
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin 30-60 mg/kg/day in 2-3 doses (target trough 15-20 mcg/ml) + Rifampicin 900-1200 mg/d. OR Vancomycin + Gentamicin 3mg/kg/d single dose + Rifampicin 900-1200 mg/d
icmr_guidelines.comments: Rifampin should be used in PVE after 3-5 days of effective antibiotic therapy, once the bacteremia is cleared

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: S. pyogenes, S. aureus
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 1.2g IV q12h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Cloxacillin 2g IV q8h / Flucloxacillin 1-2g IV q6-8h OR Cefazolin 2g IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: If risk factors for MRSA: Clindamycin / doxycycline / minocycline / linezolid

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Polymicrobial (Staph, Strep spp., Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas), anaerobes
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 1.2g IV q8h OR Ampicillin-sulbactam 3g IV q6h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6-8h OR Meropenem / Imipenem / Doripenem
icmr_guidelines.comments: Avoid FQNs. Oseltamivir only if clinical suspicion of H1N1

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: S. pyogenes, S. aureus (MRSA), Polymicrobial (anaerobes + Enterobacteriaceae)
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6h + Vancomycin 15-20 mg/kg IV q8-12h + Clindamycin 600-900mg IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin 15-20 mg/kg IV q8-12h + Clindamycin 600-900mg IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Urgent debridement advised. Clindamycin / linezolid / tigecycline recommended for antitoxin effect in GAS / Staph infections

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: E. coli, Enterococcus spp., Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp.
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Cefoperazone-sulbactam (2:1) 3g IV q12h OR Ertapenem 1g q24h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 1g IV q8h OR Imipenem 500mg q6h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Nitrofurantoin to be used only for uncomplicated cystitis

icmr_guidelines.clinical_condition: Severe PN / Emphysematous PN / Perinephric abscess
icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: E. coli, Klebsiella, Pseudomonas, Proteus, Strep spp., Anaerobes
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1g q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Colistin 9 mU loading then 4.5 mU q12h + carbapenem OR Fosfomycin 12-16 g/day in 3 divided doses
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical source control advised

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: E. coli, Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp., Pseudomonas spp., Enterococcus spp., Candida spp.
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6-8h OR Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1g q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Tigecycline 200mg LD then 100mg IV q12h +/- Polymyxin B IV 15 lac units LD then 5 lac units q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical source control where possible. Fluconazole / echinocandin if risk of IA candidiasis. Anaerobic cover needed if ceftazidime-avibactam used

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Staph aureus, CONS, Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Candida spp.
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Cefoperazone-sulbactam (2:1) 3g IV q12h OR Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6-8h + Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h OR Teicoplanin 12 mg/kg q12h x 3 doses then 6 mg/kg/d
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1g q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg q8h +/- polymyxin based on risk factors for CRE + Vancomycin / Teicoplanin
icmr_guidelines.comments: Catheter removal especially for Staph aureus, Candida spp. ALT where appropriate for catheter salvage

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: S. pneumoniae, N. meningitidis, H. influenzae, GBS, Listeria monocytogenes
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h OR Cefotaxime 2g IV q4-6h + Vancomycin 25-30 mg/kg LD then 15 mg/kg IV q8h +/- Ampicillin 2g IV q4h (if Age>60). If any suggestion of encephalitis, add acyclovir 10 mg/kg TDS for 2-3 weeks
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin +/- Ampicillin (if Age>60)
icmr_guidelines.comments: Dexamethasone 10mg IV q6h 15-20 mins prior to / simultaneously with 1st dose of antibiotic (continue for 4 days if S. pneumoniae established / cultures negative)

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Staph aureus, MRSA, CONS, GNB
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Meropenem 2g IV q8h + Vancomycin 25-30 mg/kg LD then 15 mg/kg IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: CRE risk factors: add Polymyxin B / colistin. MRSA alternatives: Linezolid / Daptomycin 10 mg/kg/d
icmr_guidelines.comments: Consider removal of shunts / devices. Intraventricular / intrathecal antibiotics may be used (ID consult advised)

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Polymicrobial, Strep, Staph, Enterococcus, GNB, anaerobes (Nocardia spp., fungal in susceptible hosts)
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h OR Cefotaxime 2g IV q6h + Metronidazole 500mg q8h +/- Vancomycin 25-30 mg/kg LD then 15 mg/kg IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Meropenem 2g IV q8h +/- Vancomycin 25-30 mg/kg LD then 15 mg/kg IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical drainage advised

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Azole-susceptible species: C. albicans, C. tropicalis, C. parapsilosis. Azole-resistant species: C. glabrata, C. krusei, C. auris (ID consult advised)
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Fluconazole IV 800 mg (12 mg/kg) loading dose, then 400 mg (6 mg/kg) daily — initial therapy in patients not critically ill or unlikely to have fluconazole-resistant Candida species
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Echinocandin (caspofungin: LD 70mg then 50mg daily; micafungin: 100-150mg daily; anidulafungin: LD 200mg then 100mg daily) for critically ill patients or if azole-resistant Candida spp. suspected
icmr_guidelines.comments: Transition from echinocandin to fluconazole in 5-7 days if clinically stable with susceptible isolate on culture & negative repeat blood cultures. 2D Echo / fundoscopy to rule out metastatic seeding

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: GNB: Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Acinetobacter spp., Stenotrophomonas maltophilia. GPC: CONS, Staph aureus incl. MRSA, Enterococcus spp. incl. VRE, Strep spp. Fungi: Candida spp., moulds, opportunistic pathogens
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6-8h OR Meropenem 2g q8h OR Imipenem 1g q6-8h OR Doripenem 500mg-1g q8h +/- Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h OR Teicoplanin 12 mg/kg/d q12h x 3 then 12 mg/kg/d +/- appropriate antifungal (if judged necessary): Echinocandin / LAmB / Posaconazole / Voriconazole (ID consult advised)
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: CRE Risk factors: Polymyxin B IV 15 lac units SD then 5 lac units q8h / Colistin 9 mU SD then 4.5 mU q12h. Ceftazidime-avibactam + Aztreonam (ID consult advised)
icmr_guidelines.comments: Polymyxin B to be started empirically if stool CRE screen positive

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: P. aeruginosa
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftazidime 2g IV q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q8h OR Ciprofloxacin 750 PO BD
icmr_guidelines.comments: Imaging to rule out mastoiditis, skull base osteomyelitis

icmr_guidelines.clinical_condition: Deep neck space infection (peritonsillar, parapharyngeal, retropharyngeal etc.)
icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: VGS, oral anaerobes, Strep spp., Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella spp., Staph aureus (Pseudomonas spp., GNB in immunosuppressed / otogenic, head and neck spread of infection)
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g IV q24h OR Ampicillin-sulbactam 3g IV q6h + Clindamycin 600mg q8h OR Metronidazole 500mg q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: If risk factors for GNB: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q8h OR Meropenem 2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 1g IV q6-8h. MRSA risk factors: Add Vancomycin / Linezolid / Clindamycin
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical drainage advised

icmr_guidelines.clinical_condition: Acute Osteomyelitis / Septic arthritis / Prosthetic Joint Infection / Implant associated infections
icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Staph aureus / Strep spp. Implant associated: MRSA, GNB, Pseudomonas, NTM
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Cloxacillin 2g IV q4h OR Flucloxacillin 2g IV q6-8h OR Cefazolin 2g IV q8h. MRSA Risk: Vancomycin 25-50 mg/kg LD then 15 mg/kg q8-12h OR Teicoplanin 12 mg/kg/d q12h x 3 then 12 mg/kg/d. GNB Risk: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q6-8h OR Meropenem 1-2g IV q8h OR Imipenem 500mg IV q6-8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g IV q24h OR Clindamycin 600mg q8h. MRSA Risk: Daptomycin 10 mg/kg/d. CRE Risk: Polymyxin B OR Tigecycline OR Fosfomycin (ID consult advised)
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical debridement advised. Empirical treatment to be deferred until sample obtained for culture. Removal of hardware to be considered

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: S. typhi — 95% resistance to nalidixic acid, 10% resistance to Amp/Chlor/CTX. S. paratyphi A
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ceftriaxone 2g q12h x 14 days OR Azithromycin 1g x 5-7 days OR Cefixime 400mg TDS x 14 days
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Chloramphenicol, TMP-SMX, high dose amoxicillin
icmr_guidelines.comments: Monitor QTc interval with high dose azithromycin

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: Shigella, Campylobacter spp., Salmonella species, Entamoeba histolytica
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Ciprofloxacin 500mg BD. Metronidazole 500mg q8h x 7-10d plus Luminal agent (Diloxanide furoate 500mg TDS x 10d)
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Ceftriaxone 1g q12h. Nitazoxanide 500mg BD x 3d plus Luminal agent (Diloxanide furoate 500mg TDS x 10d)

icmr_guidelines.common_pathogens: GNB, Anaerobes, Enterococci / E. histolytica
icmr_guidelines.empirical_ama: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g q6-8h OR Cefoperazone-sulbactam (2:1) 3g q12h plus Metronidazole 500 mg q8h
icmr_guidelines.alternate_ama: Carbapenem + Metronidazole
icmr_guidelines.comments: Surgical drainage when indicated. For amoebic abscess add Diloxanide furoate 500mg TDS x 20d

duration_of_treatment.remarks: Hemodynamically stable, no requirement for supplemental O2, afebrile for 48-72 hours
Longer courses for concomitant bacteremia, immunosuppressed host, pyogenic complications (surgical source control advised), invasive mold infections, slow response to therapy

duration_of_treatment.duration: Several months until CXR shows stable resolution / clearance
duration_of_treatment.remarks: Initial IV antibiotics suggested followed by oral agent on OPD basis. Prolonged antibiotic regimens for opportunistic pathogens / immunosuppressed hosts
Duration calculated from 1st day of negative blood cultures. At least 6 weeks for highly resistant enterococci

duration_of_treatment.duration: At least 6 weeks from 1st negative blood culture report

duration_of_treatment.remarks: Depends on extent of infection / response to treatment. At least 28 days if concomitant bacteremia
Depends on extent of infection / response to treatment. At least 28 days if concomitant bacteremia
Longer courses for extensive soft tissue involvement / osteomyelitis

duration_of_treatment.duration: 3-4 weeks depending on response to treatment & source control

duration_of_treatment.remarks: Depending on extent of source control & response to treatment

duration_of_treatment.duration: Strep pneumoniae: 10-14d. N. meningitidis / H. influenzae: 7 days. Listeria monocytogenes: 21 days. HSV: 14-21 days

duration_of_treatment.remarks: For patients with repeatedly positive CSF cultures on appropriate antibiotics, treatment should be continued for 10 to 14 days following the last positive culture

duration_of_treatment.duration: 4-6 weeks if surgical drainage done. 6-8 weeks without drainage
duration_of_treatment.remarks: Clinical and radiological resolution to be documented before stopping treatment

duration_of_treatment.duration: 14 days after the 1st negative blood culture
duration_of_treatment.remarks: Endocarditis / chorioretinitis / septic arthritis / osteomyelitis require longer courses

duration_of_treatment.duration: Discontinue antibiotic if no source identified & patient has been afebrile for at least two days and ANC is ≥500 cells/microL with a consistently increasing trend
duration_of_treatment.remarks: If source identified, treat as per site of infection
Longer courses for infections involving bone / vascular structures

duration_of_treatment.infection: Acute Osteomyelitis, Native joint septic arthritis

duration_of_treatment.duration: Pyogenic: 4-6 weeks. Amoebic: 7 days followed by luminal agent for 20 days

general_notes: 1. Timing of Surgical Prophylaxis: 'Golden Hour' (60 mins prior to incision time).
2. Incision and Closure time of the surgeries in surgeon's operative records is mandatory.

3. For surgeries extending 3 hrs of incision or 4 hrs of antibiotic administration, or if blood loss is >1.5 L, an additional dose of Inj. Cefazolin/Cefuroxime is administered. Repeat every 4 hrs subsequently when duration exceeds (half-life of Cefazolin: 1.2-2.2 hrs; half-life of Cefuroxime: 1-2 hrs).
4. Pre-operative dose is not required to be adjusted as per CrCl in renal insufficiency.
5. Repeat dose is not required in renal insufficiency.
6. For MRSA colonizers add single dose of Vancomycin in addition to the prophylaxis.
7. Duration of post-operative antibiotic usage is recommended for 24-48 hrs.
